questions.q: Which writer-and-artist pair introduced John Stewart in the early 1970s?
questions.why: Writer Dennis O'Neil and artist Neal Adams brought him in as a stand-in Green Lantern in Green Lantern vol. 2 #87.

questions.q: Which cartoon gave John Stewart the U.S. Marine background that Geoff Johns later adopted into the comics in 2007?
questions.why: Bruce Timm made John an ex-Marine for the Justice League cartoon, and Geoff Johns folded that history into the comics around 2007.

questions.q: In the comics' Cosmic Odyssey story, which world is destroyed on John Stewart's watch, a failure that haunts him?
questions.why: An avatar of the Anti-Life Equation wiped out Xanshi while John was present and unable to stop it.

questions.q: Who voices John Stewart in the 2001-2006 team-up cartoon series?
questions.why: Phil LaMarr provided John's voice across both Justice League animated series.

questions.q: Which teammate does John become romantically involved with in the original animated team series?
questions.why: The cartoon pairs John with Shayera Hol, though things sour after the finale 'Starcrossed'; he later dates Vixen in Unlimited.

questions.q: What was John Stewart's civilian profession when he debuted in the comics?
questions.why: He was introduced as an architect, which is why his ring constructs are often solid, carefully engineered structures.

questions.q: In the comics, which Green Lantern of Korugar trained John with his ring and later married him?
questions.why: Katma Tui taught John to use the ring; they fell in love and married, but she was later killed by Star Sapphire.

questions.q: In the early-1990s Mosaic story, John becomes the first mortal to join which group, taking the title Master Builder?
questions.why: Left in charge of the Mosaic World on Oa, John was made the first mortal Guardian of the Universe.

questions.q: Earth falls inside which numbered space sector that John Stewart patrols with Hal Jordan?
questions.why: Earth's Green Lantern sector is 2814, shared by John and Hal after the Corps reorganised.

questions.q: How many issues did DC publish of the ongoing Green Lantern: Mosaic series, which ran June 1992 to November 1993?
questions.why: The Mosaic spin-off from Green Lantern vol. 3 ran for 18 issues before ending in late 1993.
